correctness.rationale: Source Eqs. (1)–(5) give binomial-Bernstein mean field. For g=2, c0>0,c1<0,c2<0. For g=3, c0>0, c2<0 for 1<r<3, c3<0, while c1 arbitrary. Descartes yields one positive zero counted with multiplicity and hence a global sink. At g=4 the exact rational Fermi coefficients 1/2,1/129,1/65,8/9,1048576/1048577 produce vector-field signs +,-,+,- at 0,1/4,9/10,1, forcing exactly three simple roots by polynomial degree four. The standalone rational checker reproduces the polynomial and signs. The theorem makes no finite-population claim.

value.rationale: Distinguishes intrinsic group interaction order from distributional heterogeneity in a model whose published evidence uses mixtures of group sizes; the result gives a universal impossibility result at smaller constant group sizes and a robust exact four-person bistability certificate despite all cooperation states remaining mixed at finite temperature. Such minimality matters to identifying the mechanism of hysteresis rather than merely spotting a numerical root.
